title: Country Climate and Development Report: Côte d’Ivoire
temporal_coverage: Historical 2018 flood example; cocoa and climate projections for the 2050s
methodology: World Bank CCDR using sector analysis, climate projections and cited crop-suitability modelling.
limitations: Cocoa table cites an external model without a stated scenario.

title: Contribution Déterminée au niveau National 3.0 de la Côte d’Ivoire
temporal_coverage: Current vulnerability assessment and adaptation planning in NDC 3.0
methodology: Government NDC describing health, social and geographic climate vulnerabilities and planned adaptation measures.
limitations: The cited passages summarize diagnosis and plans; implementation outcomes are not assessed there.

title: The Climate Change and Conflict Nexus in West Africa: A New Approach for Operationally Relevant Vulnerability Assessments
temporal_coverage: Qualitative case study drawing on country literature and interviews; no single projection horizon
methodology: Qualitative Côte d’Ivoire case study triangulating literature, local and organizational reports, and semi-structured interviews.
limitations: Identifies potential risks, not causal attribution; findings are context-specific and some evidence is qualitative.

title: Quatrième Communication Nationale de la Côte d’Ivoire au titre de la CCNUCC
organization: Ministère de l’Environnement, du Développement Durable et de la Transition Écologique, Côte d’Ivoire
temporal_coverage: Historical water event in 2018; country and sector observations; RCP projections through 2050 and 2099.
methodology: National assessment using sector vulnerability matrices, historical cases and RCP climate projections.
limitations: Water and conflict examples partly cite earlier sources; conflict risk is analytical, not causal.

title: Project to Strengthen the Resilience of Local Communities in the Bafing Region Made Vulnerable due to Farmer-Breeder Conflicts Exacerbated by Climate Change: Fully Developed Proposal
organization: Interprofessional Fund for Agricultural Research and Advice (FIRCA) and Bafing Regional Council; submitted to the Adaptation Fund
temporal_coverage: Regional climate and livelihood context; four-year locally led adaptation project approved in 2025.
methodology: FIRCA's Adaptation Fund proposal with local context diagnostics and community consultations.
limitations: Historical local inputs are cited; proposed outputs are not evaluations.

title: Northern Côte d’Ivoire Crisis Response Plan 2024
organization: International Organization for Migration (IOM) Côte d’Ivoire
temporal_coverage: 2024 response-plan context and proposed activities; funding page updated 2026-02-05.
methodology: IOM response plan combines regional context analysis, planned interventions, target estimates and funding requirements.
limitations: Contextual pathways cite earlier studies; planned activities are not evaluated outcomes.
